did: I finished the living cast's follow-ups. A host that moves keeps the emotion it was showing, the bubble's clipping test now catches a broken clip, and a character listening while the other one talks waits for a pause before it fidgets. You chose that last one from an A/B preview: "B for the listener, approved". The helper that tells a listener what it hears is in place, and the record-to-video bridge has to call it. Along the way I fixed a slow test that timed out in CI, a cache that missed every frame, and cross-talk that opened false pauses, and I gave another session my podcast recipe.

calls.title: Where an emotion's run ends, for the notes a host shows
options: at a change of emotion or of character, so a move inside it changes nothing
at every beat, as before, which cut a note short when the host moved
calls.why: A move is where the host stands, not a new feeling; the note it was showing should carry on, and a new character or emotion should start fresh.
calls.undo: Say a move should restart the emotion; one function decides where the run ends.

left: #3555: the bridge from a conversation record to the video must call `hearsOf` for every listener beat, or a listener plays over the other speaker, the option you turned down.
#3577: the cast is still drawn by a separate screenshot pass, at 46 ms a frame against 0.3 ms to draw it.
#3374: the soundbites test's fixed 5 ms wait failed two of my CI runs before their re-runs; it needs its own fix.

CI lesson: marking a PR ready in the same second as a push gives a run that still sees a draft, and a ready PR is checked against the newest main, so merge main in while it's a draft and let that run finish before marking it ready.
